sourceAuditWorkbook.access: Full text extracted through Library read; local binary materialization did not complete (signed transfer returned HTTP 403).

notes: Reported URL rows are returned Search Console rows, not unique or indexed URL counts and not an inventory.
Page-family and property-level metrics are separate source scopes and are not reconciled by subtracting one from the other.
Property-level totals and the accepted 90-day page-family aggregates are separate inputs. Page-family impressions and page-family CTR are not provided.
The October 6 GSC Opportunities tab contains selected URL-level metrics, but its opportunity set is not a full family census. Those rows were not added to or summed into the family aggregates.
Missing daily rows are not zero-valued observations. The first resumed row is not release or recrawl proof.

The October 8 crosswalk workbook metadata is verified, but its workbook text was unreadable and signed-URL materialization returned HTTP 403 in this environment. The accepted page-family metrics are preserved from LIP-51 tracker comment 5155 and the bounded-sample decision in comment 12328; no unobserved crosswalk rows were transcribed.

otherPropertyScopes.overlappingUrlPrefixProperty: excluded from the reported property totals; do not add overlapping URL prefixes

queryMetrics.disclosure: No query-level values are included in this bounded comparison. Do not infer query-level movement or disclose query details from these page/property aggregates.

routeProbeSample.scope: The exact 17 dated route probes documented in the merged PR #86 crosswalk; not an exhaustive historical URL map or production recrawl.

postReleaseComparison.reason: Do not start a post-release comparison until the LIP-189 release and recrawl anchor is verified.

cancelledFollowOn.handling: Complete bounded validation within LIP-51; do not reactivate the canceled issue or revive the exhaustive-map requirement.
